snippets.title: Configure the RevenueCat iOS SDK against a RevenueDot server
snippets.code:
import RevenueCat

// Set the proxy URL before configure. Use the public app key (appl_...) from the RevenueDot dashboard.
Purchases.proxyURL = URL(string: "https://api.revenuedot.app")!
Purchases.configure(
    with: Configuration.Builder(withAPIKey: "appl_YOUR_PUBLIC_KEY")
        .with(entitlementVerificationMode: .disabled)
        .build()
)
snippets.notes: Install the SDK with Swift Package Manager (RevenueCat/purchases-ios-spm, product RevenueCat). Verification stays disabled because the stock SDK checks RevenueCat's signing key. Self-hosting: use your own server URL. The key is the app's public key, which is meant to ship inside the app.

snippets.title: Configure the RevenueCat Android SDK against a RevenueDot server
snippets.notes: The stock Android SDK still sends diagnostics and paywall events to RevenueCat's hosts in proxy mode; the RevenueDot fork (Maven group app.revenuedot.purchases) sends them to your server. The emulator reaches your computer at http://10.0.2.2:8787 and needs a cleartext network config for plain http.

snippets.title: Configure react-native-purchases (React Native and Expo) against RevenueDot
snippets.notes: In Expo Go and on the web the SDK only accepts a Test Store key (test_...). Real store purchases need a development build (expo run:ios or expo run:android).

snippets.title: Configure purchases_flutter against a RevenueDot server
snippets.notes: Flutter web ignores the proxy URL in the stock package; the RevenueDot fork fixes that. Verification defaults to disabled in this package.

snippets.title: Show the current offering, buy a package and check the pro entitlement (iOS)
snippets.notes: Check an entitlement ('pro'), never a product id, so adding a plan later needs no app update. A cancelled purchase is a normal result, not an error.

snippets.title: Buy a package and check the pro entitlement (React Native and Expo)
snippets.notes: A cancelled purchase sets userCancelled on the error. Offer Restore with Purchases.restorePurchases().

snippets.title: Buy a package and check the pro entitlement (Android, coroutines)
snippets.notes: Needs the purchases coroutine helpers and an Activity for the purchase sheet.

snippets.title: Verify a RevenueDot webhook signature on the raw body (Node.js)
snippets.notes: Pass the raw request bytes, not re-serialized JSON. The header is X-RevenueCat-Webhook-Signature. Answer 200 fast and ignore an event.id you have already handled. Load the signing secret from your backend's secret store, never from the app.

snippets.title: Store-native: buy, read entitlements and restore with StoreKit 2
snippets.notes: Store-native means you verify transactions and track renewals yourself, usually with the App Store Server API and App Store Server Notifications V2 (signed JWS payloads). Product ids must match App Store Connect exactly. Written from Apple's API names; not compiled in this repository.

snippets.title: Store-native: acknowledge a verified Google Play purchase
snippets.notes: Never grant access while the state is PENDING. Call queryPurchasesAsync on launch and when the app returns to the foreground. A backend should acknowledge from the server for better security.
